description: Christina Morales, Representstive of Texas House District 145 was sworn in at the Texas Capitol Monday along family, friends and colleagues.It was a historical day. Christina wouldn’t like to thank all of those who were there in person and those who were with us in spirit! Each of you contributed in some way to this moment. Christina is truly honored and grateful to represent District 145.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Christina Morales Campaign, Gracie Saenz, Treasurer
title: Representative Morales Sworn in
